name: Kodak Gold 200
source: Kodak Alaris, KODAK GOLD 200 Film, publication E-7022 (March 2022)

notes.characteristic: Daylight exposure, Status M densitometry, Log H Ref -1.14.
notes.sensitivity: Daylight, effective exposure 1/50 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min, sensitivity = 1/exposure (erg/cm2). Drawn as short line pieces, chained; the cyan-forming layer is drawn in two pieces (a 380-460 nm blue bump and 475-690 nm), clipped at 0.0 between them.
notes.dye_density: Diffuse spectral density, typical densities for a midscale neutral subject and D-min (no per-dye curves published).

grain.note: Print Grain Index (not rms granularity): diffuse-printing illumination, 14 in viewing distance; 25 is the visual threshold, 4 units one just-noticeable difference. Magnifications as printed (the 135 8x10 column also reads 4.4X).
